subject: Encryption ops witness snapshot, rotation runbook, and KMS SLA exhibit
messages:
From: Elena Moro <elena.moro@silverline.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: audits@silverline.com
Date: 2028-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: rotation runbook + operator separation evidence for SOC2 scope

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier today. As part of our SOC 2 readiness window we need a small evidence bundle focused on encryption and KMS controls for tenant-held keys (CAIQ/ SIG appendix). Specifically Silverline needs:

- The latest KMS rotation runbook that covers emergency rewraps and scheduled rotations (including who signs off).
- HSM operator separation matrix and a 30-day shift log extract (anonymized operator IDs are fine).
- A short "witness snapshot" with: sample KV cache telemetry for tenant requests, prefix cache eviction logs for the last 7 days, and a signed manifest for the snapshot.

Can you confirm what you can deliver by 2028-07-08? If you prefer, we can accept a staged delivery (runbook first, telemetry after). We may ask Silverline audit team to do an onsite validation later but we'll confirm.

Best,
Elena Moro
Security & Compliance, Silverline Payments

Attachment: requested_controls_matrix_template.xlsx (stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Moro <elena.moro@silverline.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: rotation runbook + operator separation evidence for SOC2 scope

Elena —

Thanks, noted. We can do a staged delivery: rotation runbook + operator separation artifacts by 2028-07-06, followed by the witness snapshot/telemetry by 2028-07-12. High-level plan below: 

1) Rotation runbook (PDF): covers scheduled rotation windows, emergency rewrap flows, sign-off owners, key versioning and fallback policies.
2) HSM operator separation & shift logs (CSV): anonymized operator IDs + shift timestamps + actions (key-import, key-wrapping, zeroize).
3) Witness snapshot (tar.gz): contains KV cache telemetry sample (scrubbed), prefix eviction logs, and a signed manifest (SHA256).

We will upload the runbook and the shift logs to a secure Drive folder and share a short access token link. For the telemetry snapshot we need to redact any PII and tenant identifiers; we plan to replace tenant ids with consistent pseudonyms in the sample.

Two quick asks for your audit team: do you need the raw HSM shift logs or will a signed digest + CSV extract suffice? Also confirm whether your auditors require the signed manifest to be timestamped by an external TSA.

I'll attach the current runbook draft (v1) to this reply for your initial review.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: rotation_runbook_v1.pdf (stub), hsm_shiftlogs_202806-202807.csv (stub)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-10T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Upload: witness snapshot ready for review

Marissa / Ben —

I uploaded the witness snapshot tarball to the Drive folder Marissa created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3Redwood-KMS-evidence (link shared with Silverline). Contents: witness_snapshot_20280710.tar.gz which includes:

- kvcache_sample_scrubbed.json (pseudonymized tenant ids, retention windows preserved)
- prefix_eviction_log_20280703-20280709.log (time-series lines)
- signed_manifest_20280710.sha256 (signed by HSM key id: hsm-ops-02)

I also exported a tiny sample of the operator shift logs showing the separation of duties for wrap/unwrap actions (rows redacted to remove internal email addresses). File: hsm_shiftlogs_202806-202807.csv.

Ben: can you confirm the SHA256 for the snapshot and paste it into the Drive readme when you have a sec?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Security Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

> > 3) Witness snapshot (tar.gz): contains KV cache telemetry sample (scrubbed), prefix eviction logs, and a signed manifest (SHA256).

From: Elena Moro <elena.moro@silverline.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: audits@silverline.com
Date: 2028-07-17T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: rotation runbook + operator separation evidence for SOC2 scope

Marissa —

Received everything, thank you. The runbook and the signed manifest look good. A couple of minor follow-ups from our audit team: 

- Can you add one paragraph to the runbook describing the SLA exhibit: expected median and p95 KMS request latencies and how Redwood measures token-level cost attribution? The auditors want this tied to the rotation policy so they can confirm there is no implicit throttling during rotation windows.
- For the HSM shift logs: please include a short legend in the CSV that maps the anonymized operator hashes to roles (e.g., operator-hash-7 => HSM_operator_oncall). No PII, just role mapping.

If you can drop an updated runbook (v1.1) and the CSV legend by tomorrow morning (2028-07-18 10:00 PT) that should close the Silverline scope. We may follow up with a short call if there are clarifications.

Best,
Elena
Security & Compliance, Silverline Payments
